progressions.advanceWhen: 6 controlled swings without bending the arms
progressions.focus: Push the bar away into the hollow and keep the arms straight, swing from the shoulders.
progressions.name: Kip swing (hollow to arch)

progressions.advanceWhen: 5 reps with the body rising and staying controlled
progressions.focus: Snap the hips up from the arch so the body floats toward the bar.
progressions.name: Kip swing with hip drive

progressions.focus: Pull right as the hips snap, then push away from the bar back into the swing.
progressions.name: Banded kipping pull-up

progressions.focus: Link reps in a steady rhythm and break before the swing falls apart.
progressions.name: Kipping pull-up

skills.why: Fran needs big sets of pull-ups, so an efficient kip decides the time and the scaling choice.

drills.name: Air squat with 3 s pause at bottom

drills.dose: 3 sets of 5 reps, adding weight each set
drills.name: Build thruster load to 95/65 lb
Primer: thrusters at working load + pull-ups (scaled as needed)

warmup.focus: Opens up hips, shoulders and lats for the thruster and pull-up, then builds the thruster to 95/65 lb. Ends with a short fast primer so the heart rate is high before an all-out sprint.

stimulus.description: A short, all-out glycolytic sprint. Thrusters should feel light enough to go unbroken or in one quick break per round; pull-ups in big sets. Target 3-6 minutes for most, under 10 max — expect intense lung and leg burn.
